title: Parsley and Poached Garlic Sauce
description: Gently simmered garlic turns mellow enough to blend by the clove into a vivid parsley sauce for cod or poultry.
equipment: Immersion blender and tall heatproof jug

ingredients.name: fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves
ingredients.note: Weigh tender leaves after picking them from the stems.

ingredients.name: smooth unsweetened blanched almond paste
ingredients.note: Pure blanched almonds, unsalted, without sugar.

steps.title: Poach the garlic
steps.text: Cover {garlic} with {broth} in the HexClad and simmer gently for 9–13 minutes until the slices mash under a spoon.

steps.title: Wilt the parsley
steps.text: Submerge {parsley} in the simmering broth for 20–30 seconds, just until wilted.

steps.title: Make the herb puree
steps.text: Blend the garlic, parsley and cooking broth with {almond} until smooth. Press through a fine sieve back into the skillet.

steps.title: Stir the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Stir in the freshly mixed slurry and cook for about 1 minute, whisking until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Check the yield
steps.text: Measure the finished sauce in a heatproof cup. Aim for 1 1/2 cups total. If it measures short, whisk in a little hot water. If it measures over, return it to the skillet and simmer briefly to the mark.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over steamed cod or tender chicken. Swirl a little through the vegetables on the same plate.

notes: Yield: 1 1/2 cups. One serving is 1/4 cup. Make ahead: Poach the garlic in broth up to a day ahead, refrigerate promptly, then add the parsley just before blending. Refrigerate in shallow covered portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze in quarter-cup portions for up to 1 month. The sauce may darken a little but its texture stays smooth. Fridge reheat: Bring a portion to a boil in a small pan, stirring until it reaches at least 165°F. Loosen with a little water as needed. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight and reheat as for a chilled portion. Option A uses five poached cloves. For gentler Option B, use one clove and the same quantity of broth. The sauce is dairy-free. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/6 of recipe): 28 kcal, 1.4 g protein, 2.6 g total carbohydrate, 1.4 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 12 mg sodium. The estimate covers the prepared condiment. Add separately served foods when totaling a meal. Fiber is estimated before straining.
